dimensions.label: 数据隐私 / Data privacy
dimensions.note: Route, service, and sensor functions could drift into identity or location profiling.
dimensions.mitigation: Use minimum public or synthetic fields, short retention, deletion, aggregate counts, and no-app equivalence.
dimensions.human_review: A named data and ethics reviewer checks purpose, fields, retention, access, complaints, and deletion before release.

dimensions.label: 实施复杂度 / Implementation complexity
dimensions.note: Three areas and several institutions require coordinated ownership and operation.
dimensions.mitigation: Begin with one authorized ninety-day pilot and expand only after evidence review.
dimensions.human_review: Planning, venue, access, safety, and operations roles sign their own conditions.

dimensions.label: 公众接受度 / Public acceptance
dimensions.note: Residents could experience an AI district as promotional, exclusive, or intrusive.
dimensions.mitigation: Prioritize daily tasks, no-registration entry, visible human help, quiet periods, and public retirement records.
dimensions.human_review: Residents and access-first users may require correction, reduction, or suspension.

dimensions.label: 运维成本 / Operations cost
dimensions.note: Staffed takeover, multilingual help, maintenance, and accessibility support create recurring cost.
dimensions.mitigation: Prove an operator and maintenance budget before permanent works; start with repairable movable components.
dimensions.human_review: Independent cost and operations review precedes long-term adoption.

dimensions.label: 政策不确定性 / Policy uncertainty
dimensions.note: Official geometry, controls, permits, and service responsibilities remain unconfirmed.
dimensions.mitigation: Keep affected values unknown or provisional and prohibit approval language.
dimensions.human_review: Relevant authorities and qualified teams confirm scope and applicability.

dimensions.label: 空间争议 / Spatial dispute
dimensions.note: Provisional key-area markers may not match the intended sites or available property.
dimensions.mitigation: Use movable prototypes and recompute the entire package from official geometry.
dimensions.human_review: Survey, ownership, heritage, ecology, transport, and venue roles confirm each location.

dimensions.label: 技术成熟度 / Technology maturity
dimensions.note: Model error, outage, mistranslation, or unsafe equipment could harm access and trust.
dimensions.mitigation: Isolated tests, physical stop, human takeover, offline routes, and explicit retirement conditions.
dimensions.human_review: Independent safety and service leads decide release, revision, or stop.

dimensions.label: 公平与包容 / Equity and inclusion
dimensions.note: Smartphone, language, sensory, mobility, or professional barriers could exclude ordinary users.
dimensions.mitigation: Provide equal no-app paths, high-contrast bilingual material, quiet access, and continuous route testing.
dimensions.human_review: Access-first users and professionals complete end-to-end testing before public release.
